name: walk
description: Terminal file manager - Navigate directories and execute files

install_steps: Install via Go: go install github.com/antonmedv/walk@latest
Or download binary from GitHub releases: https://github.com/antonmedv/walk/releases
Or use Homebrew: brew install walk
install_guidance.note: Make sure your PATH includes the Go bin directory (usually ~/go/bin) if installing via go install.

commands.description: Open walk file manager in current directory
